installation_contract: same WordPress plugin folder, bootstrap and normal ZIP update mode
migration_path: additive schema v4 with deferred locked migration; existing settings, pairing, OAuth grants, jobs, memory and logs preserved
chatgpt_primary_integration: custom ChatGPT Plugin/App via built-in remote MCP endpoint
mcp_authentication: OAuth Authorization Code + PKCE S256 with requested scopes only and optional offline_access refresh rotation
agency_runtime: SQL jobs, CAS leases, checkpoints, one recurring scheduler topology, bounded workers, DST-safe wall-clock schedules, dead letters and end-to-end Browser task correlation
execution_lane_contract: public OAuth-bound lane_handle with internal redacted legacy lane_token compatibility
correlation_contract: server-derived opaque corr_<32hex> propagated through MCP, task bridge and Browser logs
connection_state_contract: online/offline/stale/revoked are distinct; transient absence never revokes a device
h24_contract: external runner required for a real H24 guarantee; Action Scheduler is the preferred in-WordPress recurring runner and WP-Cron is fallback-only, never a parallel PR STUDIO recurring worker
evidence: redacted provenance envelopes and immutable screenshot artifacts with SHA-256 and bounded retention
high_reasoning_fast_path: playwright_flow batch + prstudio_do auto-observe content transaction
scheduler_topology: single recurring PR STUDIO worker: Action Scheduler preferred when available, otherwise WP-Cron fallback; fast continuations are isolated from periodic maintenance
crash_hardening: 17.0 removes duplicate Action Scheduler chains on topology migration, prevents parallel WP-Cron+Action Scheduler PR STUDIO workers, disables legacy Agency cron by default, and bounds one scheduled batch to a 4-second total runtime budget
core_web_vitals: LCP/CLS/INP collected from PerformanceObserver semantics based on Google web-vitals 6.x algorithms; Performance.getMetrics is not used as a CWV surrogate
upgrader_contract: plugin/theme/core updates delegate to WordPress native Upgrader classes and inherit core temporary-backup/restore behavior; no parallel proprietary updater
